description: Provenance of the Fermix mark the design module draws and the app's launcher icon and splash are made from (the M51 update's section 2, MILESTONE_51_ANDROID_MONOCHROME_AND_WELCOME_MOTION.md). Each file is a byte-identical copy of the file at source_path in the owner's design-docs repository at the pinned commit. Nothing reads them at run time and the APK carries neither: MarkGeometry.kt holds the geometry as Kotlin, and design's MarkGeometryTest holds it to fermix-mark-geometry.json, checks every digest below and that this directory holds no other file; the app's LauncherIconTest holds the launcher icon, its monochrome layer and the splash's icon to fermix-mark.svg.
provenance_note: commit is the last that changed either file (2026-10-04, "docs: M51 update, the mark's eyes are tall rounded rectangles"); they were copied from the clean checkout at read_at, where both are unchanged since commit. The mark was traced from FermixMarkMaster.png in fermix-macos, the master of the Mac app's monochrome mark.
